title: Step 63-F Address, delivery, quote, reservation, review and idempotent order submission
description: HIGH-risk Step 63-F. Productionize selection/edit of existing customer-owned Checkout Addresses, authoritative Delivery selection, Quote, tamper-evident server-only Review state, Reservation and idempotent Order creation on top of canonical Step 63-E. New Address creation remains fail-closed because the canonical API requires province_id/city_id UUIDs but exposes no public geography reference source. Payment initiation/status/verify and Order Outcome runtime remain forbidden for Stage 63-G.

dependencies.evidence: PR #308 protected workflow_dispatch 37131544917; merge job 111227485574 SUCCESS; exact-SHA postmerge 111227552033 SUCCESS; terminal Lock release comment 5970424399.

acceptance_criteria.description: Address route reads only customer-owned addresses and supports selection and safe edit of existing addresses. Existing province_id/city_id values remain opaque and unchanged; raw geography UUIDs are not exposed as customer inputs.
Delivery uses only methods and fees returned by GET /shipping-methods; optional coupon is transported only into the authoritative Quote request.
Quote output is carried to Review only in an HttpOnly HMAC-bound snapshot tied to the server-only Checkout token. Client/browser storage is never authoritative for totals or credentials.
Reservation and Order submission use stable server-generated idempotency keys and fail closed on conflict, expiry or unknown outcomes.

New Address creation must not fabricate province/city UUIDs. Until a canonical geography reference contract exists, ADDRESS_REFERENCE_DATA_MISSING remains a blocking condition and Stage 63-F remains NOT_CANONICAL.
Payment initiation/verify/status and Order Outcome runtime remain deferred placeholders for Stage 63-G; Stage F does not fabricate payment success.
Persian RTL, 44px targets, focus visibility and responsive reflow are present; credentials never enter URL, route data, browser storage or user-visible diagnostics.

Canonical completion requires resolution of ADDRESS_REFERENCE_DATA_MISSING plus exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, CodeQL Security, deterministic Review, exact-artifact Human Gate, ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 63-F is HIGH risk because it crosses authenticated address ownership, reservation and idempotent order creation. Final owner HUMAN approval must bind to the frozen exact head/artifact after technical/security gates are green. Direct-main write/raw merge prohibited.
